dn.t100: Force gear: PARAGON FRAME + SKYFALL + Glide Divine S + (Golden Halo)
dn.t101: Step 1 : The explosions go around in a full circle in this order: Red Warp → Blue Warp → Ill Gill → Green Warp → Red Warp.
dn.t102: Step 2 : Bombs appear on each player in the following order: Red → Green → Yellow → Blue, exploding from their character.
dn.t103: Based on 2 players, the bombs explode in order: Red → Green → Red → Green.
dn.t104: Based on 3 players, the bombs explode in order: Red → Green → Yellow → Red.
dn.t105: Based on 4 players: Electric attacks target players in order — Red → Green → Yellow → Blue.
dn.t106: Based on 2 players, the laser targets in order: Red → Green → Red → Green.
dn.t107: Based on 3 players, the laser targets in order: Red → Green → yellow → Red
tower.t101: [4] Thunder Maze - α - alternates danger zones in this order: 2 4 → 1 3 5 → 2 4 → 1, 3 5.
tower.t102: [1] It fires lasers in this order: 11 o’clock → 1 o’clock → 5 o’clock → 7 o’clock.
beginner.t200: Tip 3: When it comes to weapons, HIT is the top priority. 1 HIT = 1 ATA, so higher HIT directly means better accuracy.
